title: JMMMU: A Japanese Massive Multi-discipline Multimodal Understanding Benchmark for Culture-aware Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance on a newly crafted Culture-Specific (CS) subset of expert-level multimodal questions (e.g., Japanese Art, Japanese Heritage, Japanese History) to measure the models' understanding of non-Western, specifically Japanese, cultural contexts compared to English-centric benchmarks.

Comparing model performance on a Culture-Agnostic (CA) subset of questions identically presented in both English and translated Japanese to isolate and measure the performance degradation purely attributable to language variations.
